# UI Vault

> A personal, frontend-only catalog of UI components aggregated from 12 curated sources
> (animated React libraries, shadcn block registries, layout marketplaces and design galleries)
> into one categorized, searchable library. Every entry records its source, license, install
> command and — for open-source sources — a live React preview. No backend: the catalog itself
> lives in TypeScript files under src/data (175 entries, 12 sources, 26 categories).

## Sources

- [React Bits](https://reactbits.dev) — Open-source animated, interactive & fully customizable React components. (MIT, live-previewable, 25 cataloged)
- [Motion Primitives](https://motion-primitives.com) — UI kit to make beautiful, animated interfaces, faster. (MIT, live-previewable, 18 cataloged)
- [FancyComponents](https://fancycomponents.dev) — Make the web fun again. (MIT, live-previewable, 16 cataloged)
- [NumberFlow](https://number-flow.barvian.me) — Animated number component, for React, Vue, Svelte & vanilla. (MIT, live-previewable, 4 cataloged)
- [Watermelon UI](https://watermelon.sh) — 600+ free open-source components, 100+ animations, 230+ blocks. (Free, live-previewable, 12 cataloged)
- [Aceternity UI](https://ui.aceternity.com) — The React component library for beautiful landing pages. (Freemium, live-previewable, 15 cataloged)
- [21st.dev](https://21st.dev) — The living library of interfaces — 12,000+ community components. (Freemium, link-out only, 20 cataloged)
- [shadcnStudio](https://shadcnstudio.com) — 800+ shadcn blocks, 1000+ component variants. (Freemium, link-out only, 14 cataloged)
- [UI Layouts Pro](https://pro.ui-layouts.com) — 150+ premium full-page layout blocks and templates. (Paid, link-out only, 11 cataloged)
- [Cue](https://cuedesign.space) — Awwwards-tier component references, delivered as AI prompts. (Freemium, link-out only, 10 cataloged)
- [CollectUI](https://collectui.com) — Hand-curated daily gallery of the best UI on the web — 147 categories. (Free, link-out only, 15 cataloged)
- [The Component Gallery](https://component.gallery) — Component patterns from 95 design systems — 2,671 examples. (Free, link-out only, 15 cataloged)

## Categories

### Components
- `text-animation` Text & Typography (20) — Animated text reveals, scrambles, gradients and typographic effects.
- `backgrounds` Backgrounds (18) — Shader, gradient and generative backgrounds for heroes and panels.
- `3d-webgl` 3D & WebGL (5) — Globes, physics and Three.js scenes that drop into a page.
- `buttons` Buttons & Actions (6) — Buttons with borders, magnets and sparks — actions that feel alive.
- `cards` Cards & Bento (11) — Spotlight, tilt, bento and stacking card treatments.
- `navigation` Navigation (10) — Navbars, docks, sidebars, tabs, breadcrumbs and scroll progress.
- `forms` Forms & Inputs (8) — Inputs, selects, OTP, uploads, sliders, toggles and date pickers.
- `overlays` Overlays (7) — Dialogs, drawers, popovers, tooltips, toasts and command bars.
- `feedback` Loading & Feedback (6) — Spinners, progress, skeletons, empty states and notifications.
- `data-display` Data Display (4) — Tables, charts, stats, badges and avatars for showing data.
- `numbers` Numbers & Counters (7) — Animated numbers, tickers and odometers.
- `micro-interactions` Micro-interactions (20) — Cursor tricks, physics toys and small moments of delight.

### Blocks
- `hero` Hero Sections (10) — Above-the-fold sections that set the tone of a page.
- `features` Feature Sections (6) — Feature grids, bento layouts and product story sections.
- `pricing` Pricing (5) — Pricing tables, plan comparisons and checkout prompts.
- `testimonials` Testimonials & Social Proof (6) — Quotes, marquees, logos and proof sections.
- `cta` CTA Sections (2) — Big closing calls-to-action and conversion moments.
- `faq` FAQ (2) — Frequently-asked-question sections and accordion groups.
- `footers` Footers (1) — Multi-column footers, sitemaps and newsletter captures.
- `navbars` Navbars (0) — Full page-header blocks with menus and actions.
- `sections-misc` Other Sections (11) — Team, blog, contact, stats, onboarding and everything else.

### Templates
- `dashboards` Dashboards (6) — Complete admin and analytics app layouts.
- `landing-pages` Landing Pages (1) — Full marketing page compositions.
- `auth` Login & Signup (2) — Auth screens, OTP flows and onboarding.
- `full-templates` Full Site Templates (1) — Multi-page, production-shaped site starters.

### Inspiration
- `galleries` Galleries & Reference (0) — Curated screenshots and design-system patterns — reference, not code.

## Links

- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): the complete catalog in one file
- [Sources](llms/sources/): one page per source
- [Categories](llms/categories/): one page per category
- Generated by `npm run llms` from src/data — do not edit by hand.
